title: Effect of Endometrial Injury in Couples With Unexplained Infertility
brief_summary: 100 patient of unexplained infertility recruited and divided into two groups for the study group (50) endometrial scratching done in preovulatory period after controlled ovarian stimulation by clomiphene citrate , then followed and compared to control group for 6 months to asses pregnancy rate
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Unexplained infertility ( 1ry \& 2ndry infertility) : \*

  * Normal hormonal profile of infertile woman.
  * Normal hystrosalpingogram.
  * Normal laparoscopy.
  * Normal investigation of the cervical factor
  * Fertile semen analysis (according to world health organization criteria 2015).

Exclusion Criteria:

* • Infertile semen analysis.

  * Abnormal HSG.
  * Abnormal laparoscopic findings.
  * Disturbed hormonal profile.
  * Evidence of cervical factor.
  * Known genetic disorder
  * Known autoimmune disease
